en.headline: EMSD finds serious deficiencies in Tai Yip lift works at two estates
en.dek: Forty-eight lifts at Tsui Ping North and Pok Hong Estates were reported complete without fire-door frames; the department is referring the case to police and ordering repairs within a month.
body: The Electrical and Mechanical Services Department has found serious deficiencies in lift replacement works carried out by Tai Yip Elevator (Hong Kong) Limited at two tenants' purchase scheme estates.

Inspections showed that of the 48 lifts involved — nine replaced at Kwun Tong's Tsui Ping North Estate between February and July this year, and 39 at Sha Tin's Pok Hong Estate from May 2025 to July this year — the contractor installed the required fire doors but omitted the associated door-frame components, yet reported the works as completed. Fire-performance test reports had been submitted.

The department said the lifts can still operate safely but the omission is non-compliant. It has ordered Tai Yip to re-inspect the lifts, install the missing frames at its own cost, and complete the remedial works within a month. EMSD will inspect all lifts installed by the company citywide within three days and is checking other contractors.

Preliminary evidence suggests possible serious negligence or misconduct. The department does not rule out fraud or false statements and has referred the matter to the police. The Housing Authority, as owner of unsold units, said it is following up and has advised the owners' corporation of Fu Heng Estate, where a contract has not yet been awarded, to pause the process.

zh.headline: 機電署發現臺日電梯兩屋邨換𨋢工程嚴重缺失
zh.dek: 翠屏北邨及博康邨共48部升降機未裝耐火門框卻報稱完工，署方將事件轉介警方，並限一個月內完成執修。
body: 機電工程署接獲舉報後突擊巡查，發現臺日電梯（香港）有限公司在兩個租置屋邨的升降機更換工程存在嚴重缺失。
涉及觀塘翠屏北邨今年2月至7月更換的9部，以及沙田博康邨去年5月至今年7月更換的39部，合共48部。承辦商雖提交耐火效能測試報告並安裝耐火門，卻未安裝相關門框組件，便報稱完工。
署方指有關升降機仍可安全運作，但屬違規。已指令臺日覆檢並自費盡快補裝門框，執修工程將於一個月內完成。署方將於三日內巡查全港由臺日安裝的升降機，並已開始檢查其他承辦商。
初步證據顯示涉嫌嚴重疏忽或行為不當，不排除涉及欺詐及虛假陳述，已轉介警務處跟進。房委會表示高度關注，正跟進追責，並已建議富亨邨業主立案法團暫緩批出尚未簽訂的合約。
